lean.statement:
theorem forced_exponential_decay_of_scaled_dissipation_from
    {scale rate forcing : ℝ} (hrate : 0 < rate)
    (curve : DissipationCurve scale)
    (hcoercive : ∀ u : ℝ,
      rate * curve.energy u ≤ scale * curve.dissipation u + forcing)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) :
    curve.energy t ≤
      curve.energy s * Real.exp (-rate * (t - s)) +
        (forcing / rate) * (1 - Real.exp (-rate * (t - s)))
approved_definition_context: A DissipationCurve with scale q consists of real functions energy and dissipation, a proof that energy is continuous, and for every real u an exact derivative of energy within the right ray [u, infinity) equal to -q times dissipation(u).
HasDerivWithinAt on the right ray is a one-sided derivative statement. Real.exp is the real exponential function.
All parameters, function values, inequalities, products, quotients, and endpoint times in the proposition are real-valued.
